revision_implemented: r2 (Architect PROPOSED; both design reviewers APPROVED)
summary: Implemented M3.2c-perf coopmat-accelerated FlashAttention-2 as PURE SOURCE (ZERO codegen change), exactly per the r2 spec. examples/flash_attention_coopmat.axc computes S=Q·Kᵀ as a cooperative_matrix matmul into shared (s_acc DECLARED INSIDE the K/V loop body, fresh coopmat_zero() per iteration, the 4 head-dim mul_adds UNROLLED at the K/V-body top level → iteration-local, 0 coopmat OpPhi), keeps acc in shared[f32,16*64] (the crux resolution — NOT a coopmat, so the per-row correction rescale is an ordinary shared write), runs the online softmax SCALAR over the shared S tile (lane L owns row L for L<16), and the P·V + acc-rescale SCALAR over the 1024 acc cells (lane L owns {c=L+32*i}). The 4 barriers are all at conditional_depth==0 (none inside the lane<16 branch); barrier(3) is widened to cover the cross-lane corr_sh write/read. CORRECTNESS (PRIMARY) is the gate: vs the true-exp oracle max combined abs/rel diff 8.5e-5 @seq=512 and 5.1e-5 @seq=2048 (≪ FROZEN 1e-3) on a differing-rowmax fixture; cross-kernel agreement with the scalar flash_attention_exp.axc within ~8.5e-5 at seq=512 AND 2048. PERF (STRETCH ≥3×) measured ~28.8× faster than the scalar kernel at seq=2048 — but the honest attribution is that the large ratio is dominated by the PARALLELISM change (scalar @workgroup(1,1,1) one-invocation-per-row vs coopmat @workgroup(32,1,1) 16-row tile) PLUS coopmat QKᵀ, NOT a tensor-core-only figure; the remaining Amdahl ceiling (scalar P·V, 16-lane softmax, S/P shared round-trips) is what the DEFERRED coopmat-PV Option C targets. No competitive-with-llama claim.

files_created.purpose: M3.2c-perf CORE kernel: coopmat S=QKᵀ → shared + 32-lane 16-row query tile + scalar online-softmax + scalar P·V + acc-in-shared rescale. @workgroup(32,1,1), @cooperative_matrix, head_dim=64. ZERO compiler change.
key_decisions: Kᵀ via STAGING-TRANSPOSE: k_tile_sh staged as [d_full][key] (k_tile_sh[d*16+key]=K[kv_base+key][d]) so a row-major coopmat_load at offsets 0/256/512/768 stride 16 yields the 4 Kᵀ sub-blocks (B operand). Q staged row-major [16][64], loaded at offsets 0/16/32/48 stride 64 (A operand). Cross-checked by AT-2205 (a wrong transpose would diverge).

Q and K narrowed to f16 via f32_to_f16 on the shared write (Q/K buffers are f32; SharedWrite into shared[f16] requires the explicit narrow — no implicit coercion). V stays f32 in shared for the scalar P·V.

s_acc: matrix[f32,16,16,accumulator] DECLARED INSIDE the K/V loop body (fresh coopmat_zero() each iteration, 4 mul_adds unrolled at top level) → no pre-loop var_ids SSA id → not a loop-carried-coopmat phi candidate → 0 coopmat OpPhi (AT-2201).

acc_sh/m_sh/l_sh loop-carry across the K/V loop through SHARED (no OpPhi — scalars/shared never get coopmat phi). corr_sh[r] written by row-owner lane r, read by cell-owner lane c%32 in P·V, ordered by barrier(3).

files_created.purpose: AT-2204 resident wall-time A/B: times BOTH flash_attention_exp.axc (scalar) and flash_attention_coopmat.axc at seq=2048/head_dim=64 (MIN-of-20 GpuTimestamp), reports the speedup ratio + attention-TFLOPS + an honest per-phase / parallelism-attribution note. STRETCH 3× gate with the honest-negative clause. Bench ID dispatch_resident_flash_attention.

known_limitations: 16 of 32 lanes active in the softmax row-reduction (TILE_Q=16) — honest half-utilization, deferred (32-row tiles / 2-rows-per-lane).
head_dim pinned to 64; seq_len%16==0 required (host-preflight-enforced). Partial tiles / head_dim>64 / B_c>16 are follow-ons.
NVIDIA-32 (wave32) invariant: the lane→cell partitions assume subgroup size 32; multi-vendor (wave64/variable) is a documented follow-on. Lavapipe coopmat-typed-skips.
DEFERRED: coopmat P·V with a coopmat acc (needs a diagonal-scale feature — Option C, where the remaining Amdahl win lives).
deviations_from_spec: AT-2200 caps assertion: the spec's illustrative cap list was [Shader, CooperativeMatrixKHR, VulkanMemoryModel]; the kernel legitimately ALSO emits Float16 (9) and Float16Buffer (61) from the f16-shared staging — exactly the set the existing matmul_shared_coopmat.axc emits. AT-2200 therefore asserts the required four are present AND the full set ⊆ (matmul_shared_coopmat baseline ∪ {VulkanMemoryModel}), i.e. NO NEW capability vs the proven f16-coopmat kernel. This is a faithful, stronger form of the spec's intent (no new cap), not a relaxation.

AT-2204 outcome: the spec set ~1.3-2× as the EXPECTED honest-negative (Amdahl). The MEASURED result is ~28.8× — far above the 3× STRETCH bar. Reported honestly: the win is dominated by the tile-parallelism change over the deliberately-serial @workgroup(1,1,1) scalar baseline, not by coopmat QKᵀ alone. The 3× bar was NOT loosened; the correctness gate is the primary deliverable and stands; the scalar kernel's serial geometry is the baseline.
